title: feat(types,plugin-form,plugin-charts,app-shell)!: dashboard widgets bind a dataset in the catalog and docs; FormulaFieldMetadata takes the spec's expression; three display-pointer readers read displayField alone (objectui#11070, round 6)
body:
Refs #11070 · Refs #11228
Clause-②: yes (narrowing). `FormulaFieldMetadata.formula` retires for the spec's `expression` (typed by reference), `sanitizeFormData` stops reading `formula`, and three display-pointer readers (`deriveColumns` / `hydrateColumns`, `ObjectChart`, the action-param resolver, with its internal `RuntimeField.display_field` member) drop their `display_field` leg, under the startup no-gradualism rule. Item (i) alone, the dashboard round, was ruled `Clause-②: no`: it moves fixtures and docs only, and the strict face does not change. The break is priced in the changeset.

Round 6 of objectui#11070 (claim `5924126483`). Four items in one PR: (i) objectui#11228's ruling C (`5921018991`, intake `5921153525`); (ii) seat answer A on `formula` (`5923126508`); (iii) the three `display_field` consumer legs (round 5's out-of-scope finding); (iv) dated changeset notes.

## What changed

**(i) Dashboard widgets bind a dataset, everywhere objectui teaches one (objectui#11228 ruling C).**
- The six `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/plugin-dashboard/filtered-dashboard*.json` fixtures are in the ADR-0021 dataset form: every widget names a `dataset` with `dimensions` / `values`, and none carries rows. Each demo keeps its filter feature (`dateRange` presets, `optionsFrom`, text / number / lookup filters, `targetWidgets`, `filterBindings` overrides and opt-outs). **No demo was dropped**: the docs gallery's no-backend harness (`apps/site/app/components/galleryDataSource.ts`) answers `queryDataset` with placeholder rows, and the gallery render pin draws every widget title with zero dataset errors.
- The `dataset-widgets` variant is re-titled in `catalog-meta.json` ("Widgets Over Two Datasets"), because "Dataset + Inline Widgets" became false; `index.ts` is regenerated from it.
- `content/docs/guide/dashboard-filters.md`: the data-surface table becomes one paragraph (a widget binds a dataset) plus a "not an authoring surface" note naming the nine keys; the retired-shape callout, the "Dataset widgets" section, the working-examples note and Known limitations stop offering `options.data`.
- `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`'s `DashboardComponentSchema` example: the metric, the `component` chart and the `list` widget become dataset-bound `metric`, `area` and `table` widgets, and the prose under it says what a widget's data is. The standalone `chart` component's own `chartType` / `xAxisKey` / `series` section is untouched.
- The strict face is unchanged and keeps refusing the nine keys by name. Two new pins: `strict-face-read-keys-11070.test.ts` asserts each of the nine is refused by name (with a dataset-widget control that parses); `plugin-dashboard-component-schema.test.ts` asserts every `plugin-dashboard` catalog entry parses on `StrictAnyComponentSchema`.

**(ii) `FormulaFieldMetadata.expression` replaces `formula` (seat answer A).**
- `packages/types/src/field-types.ts`: `expression?: SpecField['expression']` (a CEL string or the spec's `{ dialect, source, … }` envelope). Type-level pins: by-reference identity, and `formula` joins the retired-members list.
- `content/docs/fields/formula.mdx`: the typed fence, the plaintext examples (rewritten in CEL against `record.`) and the prose. The backend section's pseudo-code goes; it said nothing true about how the platform evaluates a formula.
- `plugin-form/src/sanitize.ts`: the `if (fieldDef.formula) continue;` guard is removed after measurement (below). A new case pins that a `formula` key marks nothing computed. The `formArmsWritePayload-10563` fixture's formula column moves to `expression`.
- objectui#6526 ruling B's Studio arm is byte-identical: `ObjectFieldInspector`'s seed and clear, `ObjectFormCanvas` / `FieldStub`, `object-fields-io.ts`, `clientValidation.ts` and `retired-field-keys.ts` are not in the diff.

**(iii) The three `display_field` consumer legs.**
- `deriveColumns` / `hydrateColumns` (`plugin-form`): `d?.displayField || d?.reference_field`. Before this change they had no `displayField` leg at all, so a spec-spelled lookup got no display pointer on its master-detail grid column; it does now (probe below).
- `ObjectChart`'s `resolveGroupByLabels` (`plugin-charts`): `displayField`, then `reference_field`, then `'name'`.
- `resolveActionParams` (`app-shell`): `field.displayField ?? field.reference_field`; the `RuntimeField.display_field` member goes.
- Every comment around those reads is rewritten to be true. `reference_field` stays (`FieldSchema` declares no twin the fold could stamp it onto).
- Tests: the fixtures feeding `display_field` move to `displayField` (`deriveMasterDetail.test.ts`, `resolveActionParams.test.ts`, `expandableFamily.identity-5874.test.ts`). The two "a `display_field`-only def still resolves" pins flip to "no longer resolves", and each consumer gains a pin that keeps the snake spelling as its INPUT and shows the ingestion fold (`normalizeSchemaReferenceKeys`, objectui#7650 ruling A) delivers it as `displayField`.

**(iv) Changesets.** `.changeset/11070-dashboard-formula-round6.md` (minor for `types`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-charts`, `app-shell`; the break measured and stated). Dated, append-only notes: `.changeset/7166-retire-inert-fieldmeta-copies.md` (its `display_field` sentence was already false: objectui#7155 retired the cell's leg) and `.changeset/lucky-donkeys-shave.md` (its KEEP verdicts for these three `display_field` reads are now false).

## Files beyond the claim's named surface, each forced by the round

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` taught the same inline dialect (`options.data` / `xField` / `yField`) in a TypeScript fence and prose, outside M3's JSON corpus. A bounded in-place fix: the same defect class, a mechanical move to the ruled form, no open PR holds either file, and the README's existing gate (`readme-dashboard-examples-spec-valid.test.ts`) judges it. The seat should append both to the claim's file surface.
- `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`: one exemption entry (`area` on `schema-reference.md`). `check:doc-types` refused the rewritten example's `area` widget kind, which is a widget family and not a node type; the dashboard pages already declare `bar` / `line` this way. The script's own tests and every test that names it ran green (25 files, 1393 tests).
- `examples/schema-catalog/src/catalog-meta.json` and the regenerated `index.ts` (a title made false); comment-only edits in `DashboardGridLayout.legacyRetired.test.tsx` (it described `filtered-dashboard.json`'s widgets as inline) and `packages/core/src/utils/reference-keys.ts` (it named `deriveColumns`' `display_field` read as a kept snake read; it now names `reference_field`).

## Fork clause: not triggered

No real producer of the nine keys exists outside objectui's demo corpus.
- **objectstack** (`origin/main` `d67b94280`): `xField` / `yField` 0 occurrences in the whole tree; the six dashboard files (app-crm, app-showcase ×3, app-todo, platform-objects) carry 60 `dataset:` bindings, and their widget `options` carry `format` / `currency` / `color` / `suffix` / `showLegend` / `horizontal` / `showDataLabels`, none of the nine (that is objectstack#20960's catchall class, not here). `chartType` / `xAxisKey` hits are chart, view and page-node keys, none on a dashboard widget. Control: the same channel finds `dataset:` in all six files.
- **objectui**: no runtime host composes inline `options.data`. Writers of `options: { data` in non-test source: 0 (control: the same pattern, 25 in tests). The `provider: 'object'` writers (`anchors.ts`, `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`) build list / form VIEW configs, not dashboard widgets. `xField` / `yField` in non-test source are renderer and helper reads only.

## Probes

**Spec, installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0.** `FieldSchema` refuses `formula` on all 49 field types (`unrecognized_keys`, with the rename hint to `expression`); controls: a bare `text` def accepted, `zzz_not_real` refused, `expression` accepted both as a string and as `{ dialect: 'cel', source }`. That is H4: no served definition can carry `formula` on a non-formula type, and every `type: 'formula'` field is dropped by `COMPUTED_FIELD_TYPES` anyway. Producer census: objectstack writes `formula:` on a field only in `metadata-core`'s FLS test contract, on a `type: 'formula'` field.

**CEL.** The nine expressions `formula.mdx` now teaches all parse with `@objectstack/formula` 17.5.0's `parseCelToAst`; control: the old `created_at + 7 days` does not parse.

**Display pointer** (a scratch vitest file, copied into the worktree, run at base and head, removed by trap, never committed). A lookup whose pointer is `title`, read by `deriveColumns` / `hydrateColumns`, `resolveGroupByLabels` and `resolveActionParams`:

| def, door | base | head |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display_field`, handed in raw (BYO) | `title` · axis label from `title` · `title` | none · axis label from `name` · none |
| `display_field`, through `ObjectStackAdapter.getObjectSchema` | `title` · `title` · `title` | `title` · `title` · `title` |
| `displayField`, raw | **none** · `title` · `title` | `title` · `title` · `title` |
| `displayField`, through the adapter | **none** · `title` · `title` | `title` · `title` · `title` |

(Column order: master-detail column, chart axis, action param.) The first row is the BYO break the changeset states; the bold cells are the master-detail fix.

From `main` `95bd23c` to the merged head `2abe905`, exactly the nine dashboard pairs leave; no pair enters and no other pair moves. The last merge (`5262f7d`, objectui#11276) moved no M3 reading on this branch. **H2 holds.**

## Hypotheses

- **H1 holds in substance, not as posed.** The authors were the six fixtures and documentation only, with no real producer in either repository. But M3's seventh document was `schema-reference.md`'s example, not `dashboard-filters.md`: the guide carried the dialect in a table row and prose, which M3's JSON-fence corpus does not read. The README and `plugin-dashboard.mdx` taught it too, outside that corpus (see "Files beyond the claim").
- **H2 holds** (M3 above).
- **H3 holds.** With the member removed, `type-check` is green in `types`, `fields` (the one importer, whose `FormulaField` reads `returnType` alone), `plugin-form`, `plugin-charts`, `plugin-dashboard`, `app-shell` and `example-schema-catalog`, so no typed read existed. The untyped `formula` reads were `sanitize.ts` and the Studio arm, as posed.
- **H4 holds** (the spec probe above).

## Checks

All at the final head `139a491` unless marked. Heavy runs went through `os-verify-lock`; exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- Changeset gates, exit 0: `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; it names 26 pending changesets that cite a touched file. Each was screened for this round's keys and read where it matched; only `7166` and `lucky-donkeys-shave` are made false, and both carry a dated note), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence` (15 source files of 6 released packages, 1 changeset), `changeset:check` (no `major`). Bump: minor for `types`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-charts`, `app-shell`. `core` (one comment) and `plugin-dashboard` (a README and a test comment) publish nothing new and take no bump.
- Lint, the 18 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` / `.mjs` files, against the merge-base blobs (`--stdin`): 0 errors at head, warnings equal to base in every file, and 0 errors with `--no-inline-config` too. Population: the diff's changed script and TypeScript files, each matched by the root `eslint.config.js` (one result per file in the JSON output). Type-aware linting is off (no parser project in that config), so the diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.

**Ablations**, re-run at `139a491` with the same readings as at `2abe905` and `eddd18d`. Each prediction was written first, and each mutation went through objectstack's `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit once, blob moved, restore blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
- A1 (i): `filtered-dashboard.json`'s first widget goes back to inline `options`. The catalog schema test has 1 failed and 29 passed, and the red is the strict-face case for that entry. M3 (measured in the `eddd18d` run): those three pairs re-enter at 1 occurrence each, and strict-refused goes 82 to 83. As predicted.
- A2 (ii): `FormulaFieldMetadata` declares `formula?: string` again. `types` tsc on `tsconfig.test.json` exits 2 with one TS2344, on `assertionRetiredMembersAreGone`'s `FormulaFieldMetadata` row. As predicted. (The first attempt was refused by the tool before anything ran, because its replacement contained its anchor. It is not counted.)

## Acceptance notes

- `options.description` is in ruling C's nine, and the strict face refuses it. But `DatasetWidget` reads it on the dataset path as a metric tile's sub-caption (`CONSUMED_WIDGET_OPTION_KEYS` in `sdui-parser`). No producer writes it in either repository. It belongs to objectstack#20960's catchall census (a consumed key the strict face refuses), not to this round. Noted, not filed.
- The dashboard renderer's inline read (`options.data ?? widget.data`, `xField || 'name'`, …) is untouched, as ruled. It retires on its own card.
- objectui#11228 stays `pm:blocked` on this card. It closes with a pointer once this is on `main`.
